prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. One original carved architectural CORBEL for a hand-painted tabletop game. A stout wall bracket with a flat vertical back and a thick flat horizontal projecting top slab; below the slab the load-bearing carved support is a large radiant round SUN FACE with eight short thick triangular rays. Clearly a bracket to carry a beam, not a freestanding statue. Size proportions 24 inches wide, 24 deep, 30 tall. The large faction carving projects forward and remains visible from above; top slab is shallow enough not to hide it. Warm golden ochre and ivory. Heroic hand-painted style: stout miniature-safe forms, broad soft bevels, clean part separation, matte painted gradients and restrained texture. Exactly one isolated complete object, three-quarter elevated view at 35 degrees looking down, front and one side visible, generous margin. Transparent background, no floor, no wall, no actual beam, no cast shadow, no lettering, no logo, no extra objects. Text-only original design, no published deity or product.
